content: In this thread we will collect the PRs needed for polyhedral geometry/combinatorics. See this thread for discussion on the topic. PRs were previously listed there, and I will not copy over the closed ones.

• #34007 Duality operator for submodule

This one is particularly important in the long run because duality theory for convex cones will build on it. It is currently blocked by the discussion whether and how it should be merged with orthogonalBilin, see #mathlib4 > Unifying `Submodule.dual` and `Submodule.orthogonalBilin`. Input is welcome.

• #34487 More typeclass support for bilinear forms

I appreciate input at #mathlib4 > More typeclass instances for bilinear forms

• #35323 Some useful lemmas for PointedCone.dual

This one got stuck for a while at the decision for names for some of the proposed lemmas. See also #PR reviews > Appropriate name cone duality lemmas .
(deleted)
• #36634 A pointwise negation lemma

• #33780 Lineality space for pointed cones

This is also a central part of the theory of cones and has been open for a while. It is also a prerequisite for the face theory (see next PR below).
• #33664 Face lattice of pointed cones

• #36689: Symmetric submodules are modular elements in the lattice of submodules over a semiring

I am not aware of an implementation of right/left-modular elements, so I stated the lemmas without using the language of modular lattices. This PR includes specialized cone versions which are relevant in cone theory.

I merged/delegated some of the easier ones.

• #36946 Duals of finitely generated cones

Adds the notion DualFG for cones that can be written as the dual of a finite set, or equivalently, that are duals of finitely generated cones. This is conceived as a counterpart to PointedCone.FG in preparation for Minkowski-Weyl theory.

• #36953 Renaming PointedCone.span to PointedCone.hull

This was the outcome of the discussion here: #mathlib4 > Design for positive cones @ 💬 . And it sets a precedent for the future: symmetric objects have a span (e.g. submodules, affine subspaces, ...), non-symmetric ones have a hull (cones, convex sets, ...).
Scary typo in your message :scream:
• #36605 Interaction between hull, span and negation

• #37323 Generalizing cone duality from CommRing to CommSemiring

The majority of duality theory did not depend on the stronger assumption. The two exceptions are moved to a separate section.

• #37381 Removing IsOrtho

First step in cleaning up bilinearity/orthogonality in preparation for implementing functionality from Submodule.dual. See also #mathlib4 > Reorganizing bilinearity and orthogonality? .

• #37389 Generalizing orthogonalBilin and simplifying orthogonal

This is an extract from the above cleanup PR.

• #37464 Minor additions to pointed cones

Extract from PR 36605.

• #37542 Deprecating Module.dualPairing

Another cleanup of orthogonality theory.
• #37484 Improving fg_induction
• #37950 Adding lemmas about order and MonoidHomClass

• #37951 Rework PointedCone.dual to take a cone as input in place of a Set

This one might be controversial (see discussion starting here). Feedback is welcome (ideally here or here). In essence: I think it would be cleaner to have PointedCone.dual take a cone as input rather than a Set. Three main reasons:

  • to untangle the intended functionality of PointedCone.dual and PointedCone.hull.
  • to align PointedCone.dual with the signature of its submodule analogue Submodule.orthogonalBilin (partially, with proposed functionality from #34007).
  • In my opinion it becomes easier to use. I am using cone duality extensively, and have to coerce between sets and cones all the time for no good reason.
• #38013 Reverse import order between Submodule/Pointwise and Span/Basic
Could someone have a look at #37464 (minor additions to cones) and #36605 (interaction between hull, span and negation). I am currently bottlenecked by those. The second one depends on the first one.

The following PRs have been in review for quite a while:

  • #33664 (face lattices) - created in January, over 200 comments, but the latest changes are very minor. This is a very important PR and bottleneck for polyhedral theory.
  • #37464 (minor additions to pointed cones) - very minor, already 3 approvals, but the final call is missing

Could someone please help us moving them along?
Oh, I wasn't aware of the face lattice PR. I'll take a look.
I would prefer if IsFaceOf were a predicate on convex sets. The fact that (nontrivial) faces of pointed cones are pointed cones should be a theorem, rather than definitionally true.
Actually, here's an idea. We could redefine PointedCone.IsFaceOf F C as F.Nonempty ∧ IsFaceOf F C, which I think should be equivalent to C.lineal ≤ F ∧ IsFaceOf F C.
(I'm not as familiar with convex cones as I am with convex polytopes, so please do correct if I'm wrong)
Thanks for the feedback. Could we discuss this in the polytope thread to keep the PR thread clean? I will answer there.

• #42647: Add polytopes

This is a minimal version of polytopes for mathlib. It does not yet implement any non-trivial theorems. For example, we cannot yet define the intersection of polytopes. These will follow in future PRs.
